column1: # Findings the Arlington oracle (arlington_test.go) makes on conformant (-pass-)
# veraPDF corpus files: every one a fact about the file, checked against its raw
# bytes, and none pdf0 misreading it. TestArlingtonCorpusParserFaithful fails on
# a finding not listed here and on one listed that is no longer made.
# Two kinds, verified on 2026-10-28:
#   - "missing required /P" on a structure element (ISO 32000-2 Table 355: a
#     StructElem's /P, its parent, is required). Thirty files have elements
#     that lack it. For each file, the set of structure elements without /P
#     that pdf0 reads was compared with the set read from the raw bytes by an
#     extractor independent of pdf0's parser (top-level keys of every object,
#     object streams decompressed); the two agreed for all thirty. veraPDF
#     passes them because no PDF/A or PDF/UA rule asks for /P.
#   - 6-3-1-t01-pass-d's RichMedia annotation (object 11) has /NM /an1, a name
#     where ISO 32000-2 12.5.2 gives a text string, and its RichMediaContent's
#     /Views [21 0 R] is the empty dictionary << >>, without the /XN its
#     grammar requires.
# Regenerate with `go test -run TestArlingtonCorpusParserFaithful
# -update-arlington .` and trace every added line to the file before keeping it.
